name: regression: extrapolation speed is capped at vMax
description: Pins a speed estimate above vMax causing at() to extrapolate too fast.

steps.why: First fix is 100 m along the route.
The window permits at most 25×1 + 100 = 125 m forward, so this fix projects at 225 m.
Raw speed is (225 − 100)/1 = 125 m/s, but vMax caps it at 25 m/s. One second after the fix, drawing is 225 + 25×1 = 250 m.
